_comment: The workflows the dashboard's CI health shows, each once, read by utils/kernel_checks/ci_health.py. critical: the tests that gate a merge (they run in the merge queue): judged on their latest run on main, any event, and measured over the last days; every is how often main runs them (hours; late past 1.5 of it), legs also records that run's jobs. workflows: the other scheduled jobs, judged on their latest scheduled run; every is the cron period in hours.

critical.title: Linux hardware tests
critical.why: lit and IRON tests on npu1 and npu2; the only hardware test of main

critical.title: Windows hardware tests
critical.why: the same on a Windows Strix Halo machine

critical.title: Compile across platforms
critical.why: compilers, assertions and RTTI on Linux and Windows

critical.title: Python versions
critical.why: the tests on each supported Python

critical.why: clang-tidy, pyright and the docs checks
